GND 1155506758 (the item's P227) is sameAs LC n2004001814 and Wikidata Q133633232 (lobid.org/gnd, 2026-11-02); the item has no P244; GND, VIAF and ISNI ids as the item states them (P227, P214, P213), GND's own sameAs agreeing on VIAF
